findings.claim: Baseline requires byte-exact E1/E2 answer reproduction across all 2700 tasks before any optimizer update; misalignment between Flip definition and parent model's operational expectations constitutes a candidate logical contradiction.

recommended_next_step: Verify that F1 'complement only the first word's five INFORMATION bits' preserves exact binary output format expected by E1/E2 S-append logic under inherited parent checkpoint P030.
summary: The specification defines a mixed continuation protocol where E1/E2 expect complete 6-bit words followed by S, while F1 introduces a bitwise complement operation on information bits with distinct append syntax; the contradiction lies in whether F1's modified first word disrupts the sequential word completeness required by E1/E2 termination prefixes.
unknowns: how F1 complement interacts with E1/E2's requirement of full 6-bit word completion before S generation
